# netbox_device_interface_primary_mac_address (Resource)

Sets the primary MAC address of a device interface. The address must be assigned to that interface (netbox_mac_address with device_interface_id). Import with the interface id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "test-manufacturer"
}

resource "netbox_device_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "test-device-type"
}

resource "netbox_device_role" "test" {
  name = "test-device-role"
}

resource "netbox_device" "test" {
  name           = "test-device"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.test.id
}

resource "netbox_device_interface" "test" {
  device_id = netbox_device.test.id
  name      = "test-interface"
  type      = "1000base-t"
}

resource "netbox_mac_address" "test" {
  mac_address         = "00:11:22:33:44:55"
  device_interface_id = netbox_device_interface.test.id
}

resource "netbox_device_interface_primary_mac_address" "test" {
  device_interface_id = netbox_device_interface.test.id
  mac_address_id      = netbox_mac_address.test.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_interface_id` (Number) Id of the device interface.
- `mac_address_id` (Number) Id of the MAC address to make primary; it must be assigned to the interface.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The interface id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The id of the device interface.
import {
  to = netbox_device_interface_primary_mac_address.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id of the device interface.
terraform import netbox_device_interface_primary_mac_address.test 123
```
